flow: Pull Kalshi and Polymarket catalogs through their APIs in 200-event cursor pages, cache scrapes in SQLite or Streamlit, and keep RSA keys in .env files outside the code

Run every cross-venue pair through the equivalence verdict, read the contract rules, and re-price each scanner gap on the compare tab before funding it

Run the bot dry with a $10 cap and read the logs for the snapshot, the estimate, and the trade-or-skip reason before enabling live trades
Mimic market orders with fill-or-kill at an aggressive price, hedge any unfilled leg at the calculated size, and budget an hour to more than 12 hours for Kalshi settlement
